instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot from a low angle looking up an indoor marble staircase. A man with dark curly hair (R2) in a gray blazer and black pants stands on a lower step with a tan backpack, looking down at a notebook. A woman with ginger hair (R1) wearing glasses, a dark blazer, and tan pants stands on a higher step, holding the open black notebook and smiling towards the camera. The background is brightly lit from above, creating a high-contrast, overexposed upper frame with neutral tones.
elements: R1 stands on a higher stair step while R2 stands on a lower step
R1 holds the open black notebook while R2 looks down at it
R2 carries a tan backpack while R1 is the notebook holder
